trending_skills.name: Security Audit Tools — Pre-Install Skill Inspector
trending_skills.description: Inspect third-party OpenClaw skills, npm/pip packages, shell installers, and GitHub Actions before downloading. Flags malicious patterns, exfiltration attempts, and permission escalations.
trending_skills.why_trending: 16 downloads and climbing. Critical timing — supply chain attacks on OpenClaw skills documented this week. If you install community skills, run this first.

ai_tweets.headline: China's OpenClaw gold rush: hustlers cashing in on 1,000-person meetups
ai_tweets.detail: MIT Technology Review reports OpenClaw meetups in China drawing 1,000+ attendees — standing room only. Chinese AI giants (Tencent, Zhipu, Baidu) are piggybacking on the trend, promoting their models and APIs as OpenClaw-compatible. A parallel ecosystem is forming at speed.
ai_tweets.takeaway: China's OpenClaw adoption is organic and bottom-up — meetups, courses, developer tools. The government push (Shenzhen grants) meets grassroots demand. Meanwhile state enterprises are pulling back on security grounds. Two Chinas, one agent platform.

ai_tweets.headline: Bloomberg publishes 'What Is OpenClaw' explainer — mainstream awareness hits critical mass
ai_tweets.detail: Bloomberg's 'What Is the OpenClaw AI Agent and Why Is It Popular in China?' marks the moment OpenClaw crosses from tech press to mainstream financial media. 250K+ GitHub stars, fastest open-source project growth in history.
ai_tweets.takeaway: When Bloomberg writes the 'what is this' explainer, you're past early adopters. This is the institutional awareness moment. Expect more enterprise pilots, more VC funding, and more competition (Nvidia NemoClaw, OpenAI Codex agents) in the next 30 days.

ai_tweets.headline: OpenClawd releases cloud-hosted platform update — AI agent adoption at record levels
ai_tweets.detail: OpenClawd AI shipped a major platform update for cloud-hosted OpenClaw deployments. The company reports record adoption levels across Asia and North America. Cloud hosting removes the biggest barrier to non-technical agent adoption.
ai_tweets.takeaway: Cloud-hosted OpenClaw is the gateway for enterprises that won't self-host. As adoption goes mainstream (Bloomberg explainer, 1000-person meetups), managed hosting becomes the business model. Watch whether this fragments the ecosystem or accelerates it.

ai_tweets.headline: AI agent security risks in 2026 — practitioner's guide documents OpenClaw supply chain attacks
ai_tweets.detail: A detailed practitioner's guide documents the 'OpenClaw malicious skills crisis' as the largest confirmed supply chain attack targeting AI agent infrastructure. Skills can exfiltrate data, escalate permissions, and compromise host systems.
ai_tweets.takeaway: This is the agent ecosystem's npm/PyPI moment. Community skills are powerful but unaudited code running with system access. The Security Audit Tools skill (trending above) is a direct response. Expect OpenClaw to ship built-in sandboxing soon.

prompt_hack.name: Defensive Skill Installation Pattern
prompt_hack.description: Before installing any community skill: (1) Read the SKILL.md source on GitHub first, (2) Check for shell commands, API calls, or file writes outside the workspace, (3) Run in a sandboxed environment for the first session, (4) Monitor network calls. One-liner: 'Before installing [skill], read its source at [repo URL] and flag any commands that write outside ~/.openclaw/workspace or make external API calls.'
prompt_hack.use_case: Protects against the supply chain attacks documented this week. Turns your agent into its own security auditor.

community_build.name: China Agent Stack — Full Ecosystem in One Week
community_build.description: The past 7 days saw China build a complete agent ecosystem: Tencent WorkBuddy (enterprise), Shenzhen government grants (policy), Xiaomi MiClaw (mobile), 1000-person meetups (community), and now hustlers running OpenClaw bootcamps. Hardware + software + mobile + policy + capital — all in one week. No other country has moved this fast on agent infrastructure.
